title: [3.0-beta7] MDT: Bolus Windows remains open
body:
Sometimes the Bolus windows remains open.
* Bolus
* see the message "waiting for disconnect"
* see the messaage "sheduled status refresh"
* see the message "waiting for disconnect"
* the  Bolus Window remains open until I press the stop butoon.

Log send to @andyrozman 

Messages:
![Waiting to disconnect](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1705174/143690158-3c7b0dc5-6f47-4824-8571-3562ef31cbc8.png)
![Sheduled Status Refresh](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1705174/143690159-d184399c-fadc-4c58-89ca-1f4c9f27bbb4.png)

comments.body:
I'm able to replicate this as well (it seems to always occur in my test environment though I only tested while temp basals were active). Note that:
- The dialog continues to display 'Going to bolus x U' even after the bolus has been given (and the bolus was always given in my testing--as verified directly on the pump and in the AAPS treatments tab)
- The dialog continues to display indefinitely until the Android screen timeout kicks in. Upon re-activation of the display, the dialog is no longer displayed.
So it looks like it's mainly a UI issue, but a serious one since it confuses users as to whether the bolus was given or not, and since it presents a STOP button that actually does nothing (it can be clicked long after the bolus has completed, giving users the impression that a bolus has been stopped even when it's already been given).

A secondary issue (I'm not sure if it would be considered a separate bug) is that the bolus status dialog always disappears as soon as the screen timeout kicks in--even when the bolus hasn't yet completed.

---------
Tested on 2.8.2.14dev 2021.11.30 19:29 running on an S7/Android 11 | Orangelink | MDT 554
